functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Pierced by the musculocutaneous nerve itself -- a classic anatomical landmark relationship.

trigger_points.location_description: Point in the proximal belly, palpated through the anterior axillary fold against the humeral head with the arm slightly abducted.
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Anterior deltoid pain, then a projection down the posterior arm, dorsal forearm and dorsum of the hand (often described as skipping segments).
trigger_points.activation_perpetuating_factors: Pain reaching behind the back and combing hair (combined extension-abduction stretch); difficulty with sustained front-carry.
trigger_points.notes: Typically appears as a 'second-layer' source, after other anterior-shoulder muscles' trigger points have been treated.
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons Trigger Point Manual -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded shoulder muscle reference document (Donnelly JM, Fernandez-de-las-Penas C, Finnegan M, Freeman JL (eds), Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual, 3rd ed., Wolters Kluwer, 2019)
